body:
Problem: `Series.mode(dropna=False)` raises a `TypeError` for a nullable boolean Series because, on the masked return path in `algorithms.mode`, the counting results are returned as numbers instead of being converted back to booleans.

Fix: Call `_reconstruct_data` on that return path, as the normal path already does, so the result has the correct dtype before the `BooleanArray` is built.

Testing: Added a test covering four cases (a tie, a clear winner, NA as the most frequent value, and all values missing). These fail before the fix and pass after it, and the 280 existing `mode` tests also pass. I ran these locally against pandas 3.1.0rc0 with the change applied.

AI disclosure: I used Claude Code with the claude-opus-5-5 model (medium effort). It found the bug, wrote the fix and the tests, and ran the tests. I reviewed and understood every change before submitting.
